card_summary: Lower mountains (~30%) and dry the climate: cut ocean rain budget, sea moisture pickup, sea-surface humidity, and raise dryness so interiors lose more rain.

events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Make the climate drier and the mountains lower.
Looked up 8 matching actions first (about 502 tokens).
The model is reading the climate, weather, world settings…
MODEL PROPOSAL
“Lower mountains (~30%) and dry the climate: cut ocean rain budget, sea moisture pickup, sea-surface humidity, and raise dryness so interiors lose more rain.”
Peak altitude  (peak_m)   4000 m  ->  2800 m   -30%
    “Lower the mountains: peak altitude down ~30% from 4000 m.”  (model's words)
Ocean supply  (climate.ocean)   1.00 ×  ->  0.75 ×   -25%
    “Cut the global rain budget by a quarter for a drier world.”  (model's words)
Evaporation  (climate.evap)   0.12  ->  0.10   -17%
    “Less moisture picked up over the sea (down ~17%).”  (model's words)
Sea-surface humidity  (climate.ocean_hum)   1.00  ->  0.85   -15%
    “Drier sea air feeding the map.”  (model's words)
Dryness  (climate.rain_dep)   0.35  ->  0.42   +20%
    “Air rains out sooner; land past the first ridge dries further.”  (model's words)
5 settings refresh the climate with Recompute in the status bar.
Applying changes the settings, then refreshes the climate. The world itself is not replaced.
[Dismiss]
[Apply and regenerate]
